label: Premium Next.js app (App Router, themeable)
description: A premium, multi-route Next.js (App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind v4) app with a real component library — shadcn-style Radix UI primitives, lucide-react icons, framer-motion, react-hook-form + zod forms, and TanStack data tables — plus a landing page, login/signup, dashboard shell, settings, and 6 swappable color palettes. The AI fills the main-feature region with the user's idea.
notesBlurb: PREMIUM Next.js skeleton (nextjs-premium): a complete, styled App-Router app with a real library stack. ALREADY WORK: the stack/config (package.json, next.config.ts, tsconfig.json), landing (app/page.tsx), auth (app/login + lib/auth.ts mock localStorage session), app shell (app/(app)/layout.tsx sidebar+topbar guard), Dashboard + Settings, 6-palette theming (app/globals.css [data-theme] + components/theme-picker.tsx), AND a premium component kit in components/ui/* (shadcn-style on Radix UI, styled with the Helix theme tokens): button, card, input, label, badge, separator, skeleton, avatar, dropdown-menu, dialog, tabs, tooltip, sonner toast, form (react-hook-form+zod), table + data-table (TanStack). Helpers: lib/utils.ts `cn`, components/fade-in.tsx (framer-motion). Icons: lucide-react. Toasts: `import { toast } from 'sonner'`. Your job: set the product name in lib/config.ts, replace the region marked 'AI: BUILD THE APP'S MAIN FEATURE HERE' in app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx (the DataTable is the pattern), relabel the stat cards, add pages by copying an app/(app)/<route>/page.tsx + a NAV entry in components/sidebar.tsx. REUSE components/ui/* + the color tokens (bg-bg, bg-surface, border-line, text-ink, text-muted, bg-brand text-brand-fg, bg-accent, bg-danger). Do NOT recreate the config/scaffold, rebuild auth/layout/nav, swap Tailwind out, touch the palette system (HELIX-LOCKED in globals.css + theme-picker.tsx), re-init shadcn, or add dependencies unless truly required (keep it building).
